scope: PR-A repository-wide InputXML producer, consumer, dialect, field-occurrence, and component-shape inventory
nextPhaseGate: PR-B is blocked until every gap marked PR_A_BLOCKING has an owner or explicit disposition.
detectionRule: Detection identifies intake profile only. It is never proof of canonical validity.

dialects.name: caesar-native-inputxml
dialects.role: canonical-source candidate and native benchmark evidence
dialects.adapterPolicy: strict intake profile; no alias acceptance in canonical document
risks: current writer does not enforce XML_TYPE or exactly-one PIPINGMODEL
fixture versions and field spellings vary

dialects.name: app-generated-stagedjson-inputxml
dialects.adapterPolicy: compile with ledger; block unresolved skips/truncation/defaults
risks: PRESSURE1..9 spelling differs from Python reader PRESSURE_C1..9

dialects.name: app-generated-node-xml-inputxml
dialects.adapterPolicy: reconcile synthetic topology/defaults and produce entity dispositions

dialects.name: component-topology-lineage-inputxml
dialects.adapterPolicy: must separate extension namespace and repair component auxiliary parity before canonical acceptance
risks: positive bend control count without BEND child

dialects.name: pdf-generated-cii14-inputxml
dialects.adapterPolicy: not accepted by CII(2019) canonical path without explicit migration proof

dialects.name: xml-to-cii-diagnostic-sidecar-inputxml
dialects.adapterPolicy: may be evidence input only; cannot substitute writer-consumed model

dialects.name: enriched-inputxml
dialects.adapterPolicy: canonical compiler must reconcile source and mutations with ledger

dialects.name: categorized-inputxml-v3
dialects.adapterPolicy: compile only after normalized/source-evidence reconciliation and strict evidence validation

dialects.name: root-branch-node-source-xml
dialects.role: source node XML / CleanXML, not InputXML
dialects.adapterPolicy: must compile through node-to-canonical adapter before InputXML

dialects.name: pipesstressexport-psi116-xml
dialects.root: PipeStressExport or repository PSI source root
dialects.adapterPolicy: dedicated intake adapter; never use mega-XSD
risks: different field names and topology semantics from InputXML

dialects.name: inputxml-fragment
requiredSignature: one or more PIPINGELEMENT records without canonical root
dialects.adapterPolicy: wrap only with explicit source role and validate; canonical output must be full document

dialects.name: inputxml-changeset-v1
dialects.adapterPolicy: applies to evidence before canonical compilation

dialects.name: nodeset-v1
dialects.adapterPolicy: never route to InputXML compiler without a separately approved engineering source adapter
risks: synthetic comparison coordinates and generated IDs
